about: Tracks every upstream Ice (jordanbaird/Ice) issue triaged for Icey. Scripts/build-site.py turns it into docs/upstream-issues.md and the website. Edit this file, never the generated page. status: fixed | partial | open | not-a-bug | feature. fixed_in: the Icey release tag that ships the fix, or null if it is not released yet. pr: the Icey pull request with the fix.

issues.title: Ice has noticeable energy impact during mouse movement
issues.headline: Ice uses energy every time you move the mouse
issues.symptom: Moving the mouse raised Ice's energy use in Activity Monitor, even with "Show on hover" turned off.
issues.fix: Icey only listens to mouse, scroll and drag events while a setting that needs them is on.

issues.title: Energy impact
issues.headline: Ice has a high energy impact in Activity Monitor
issues.symptom: Ice showed a high energy impact in Activity Monitor during normal use.
issues.fix: Icey stops listening to system-wide mouse events it doesn't need, so it stays near zero energy impact while idle.

issues.title: High CPU usage
issues.headline: Ice uses a lot of CPU after switching apps
issues.symptom: With menu bar appearance settings on, Ice's CPU use spiked after every app switch, because it polled the app menu every millisecond.
issues.fix: Icey polls with a back-off, and only for the split shape, which needs the app menu's width.

issues.title: memory leak in WindowServer caused by Ice?
issues.headline: WindowServer memory grows while Ice runs
issues.symptom: After the Ice Bar was shown once, Ice captured the menu bar every 5 seconds forever, which kept WindowServer busy and growing.
issues.fix: Icey only captures the menu bar while the Ice Bar is visible, and only captures the wallpaper for shapes that draw it.
issues.note: Icey takes far fewer captures. A WindowServer leak inside macOS itself can't be ruled out.

issues.title: high memory usage
issues.headline: Ice's memory use grows over time
issues.symptom: Ice's memory grew over long runtimes.
issues.fix: A screen capture leak is fixed, and the menu bar item image cache is pruned instead of growing without limit.

issues.fix: Icey is built on Ice's Tahoe rewrite, and its helper for identifying menu bar items now connects reliably, so the layout shows your items.

issues.title: Unable to proceed past permissions request.
issues.headline: Ice keeps asking for a permission that is already enabled

issues.fix: Icey explains what to do: remove the app from the list in System Settings with the minus button, then add it again. Screen Recording granted while Icey runs now takes effect without a relaunch. The permissions window now also has a link that opens the right System Settings list, where a stale entry can be removed.

issues.symptom: A Mac froze after about 33 hours of uptime with Ice running. Ice retried moving an item every 3 seconds forever when it couldn't put it back.
issues.fix: The crashing code from Ice 0.11.12 is gone. Retries now back off and stop after five rounds, and Icey recovers when its divider reappears.
issues.note: The freeze itself hasn't been reproduced.

issues.title: MacOS Tahoe 26.5 update broke hidden elements in ice layout

issues.fix: When the always-hidden divider ends up on the wrong side, Icey now moves it left of the items that were hidden, and it saves where its dividers are when it quits.

issues.title: When icon for Intego One is moved from hidden to visible bar in settings, the icon disappears

issues.title: Removed icon from tray and can't get it back

issues.title: App opens in dock when expanding the bar
issues.headline: A Dock icon appears when you show hidden items
issues.symptom: Showing hidden items made the app appear in the Dock for a moment.
issues.fix: This is how "Hide application menus" works: it makes the app active for a moment. Turn that setting off, or use the Ice Bar.

issues.title: Orphaned application menu-bar windows stuck at CGWindow layer 101, invisible to accessibility
issues.headline: Orphaned menu bar windows stuck at layer 101
issues.symptom: Invisible menu bar windows stayed on screen.
issues.fix: Not caused by Ice: the reporter saw it with the setting off and after removing Ice.

issues.title: OneDrive icons

issues.symptom: OneDrive's icons ended up in the always-hidden section.
issues.fix: Some apps don't remember their item positions, so macOS places them in the always-hidden section. See the frequent issues page.

issues.title: Unsplash client crashes shortly after being hidden by ICE

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice triggering while clicking just under the menu bar in fullscreen
issues.headline: Clicking just under the menu bar in fullscreen triggers Ice
issues.symptom: In fullscreen, clicking just below the hidden menu bar showed the hidden items.
issues.fix: The top of a fullscreen display counts as the menu bar only while its menu bar is showing: with the Icey icon on another display, and now also with the Icey icon turned off.

issues.title: [Bug]: Can not work with Focus Menu Bar Item (https://heyfocus.com)

issues.note: Same fix as #403. Reported on Ice 0.10.5 and not retested with Focus.

issues.title: [Bug]: When turning off "Show ice icon" and the turning it back on, the icon doesn't automatically repopulate

issues.note: Same as #801.

issues.headline: Show items only when their icon changes or a condition is met

issues.title: [Bug]: Persistent Issue: New Icons Default to "Always Hidden"
issues.headline: New menu bar items always go to the always-hidden section

issues.title: [Bug]: Discord little ball (notification when you're in a call) moves from the bar to hidden.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: <Optimize Battery Icon appearance>
issues.headline: Show the battery percentage inside the battery icon

issues.title: [Bug]: The DingTalk icon needs to be reconfigured every time it is restarted

issues.title: [Bug]: After restart, app icon always moves to "always-hidden" section

issues.title: [Bug]: Position of menubar icons in hidden section are not remembered

issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Bug]: eul keep being sent to Always Hidden Section

issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.note: Same as #801 and #787.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Keep icons which are only enabled while app is open shown!

issues.note: Related to #6 and #344.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Custom padding top & horizontally for pill shaped designs

issues.title: [maybe Bug]: AirBattery Icon moves to always hidden
issues.headline: AirBattery item moves to the always-hidden section after sleep

issues.title: [Feature Request]: introduce profiles to handle macbook's notch conditionally
issues.headline: Use the Ice Bar only on the notched built-in display

issues.title: [Bug]: Menu renders incorrectly on secondary monitor in dual-screen setup

issues.title: [Bug]: MacBook Pro M4 w/ Notch - icons disappearing 'underneath' the notch I guess?
issues.headline: Icons disappear under the notch

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Allow profiles

issues.symptom: A request for layout profiles such as Home and Travel.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Bug]: Hidden Items shown by menu bar on 57in monitor

issues.title: [Bug]: "Ice can't display menu bar items for automatically hidden menu bars" error

issues.title: [Bug]: App blocking option+a

issues.symptom: Option-A no longer typed å while Ice was running, because it was saved as the always-hidden section's hotkey while that section was turned off.
issues.fix: Icey no longer registers the always-hidden section's hotkey while that section is turned off, so its keys type normally again.
issues.note: The hotkey recorder is hidden while the section is off. Turn the section on to change or clear the hotkey.

issues.title: [Bug]: Menubar item arrangement not sticking
issues.headline: BetterDisplay item loses its place after the app restarts
issues.symptom: After restarting BetterDisplay, its item went to the hidden section or to the end instead of where it was placed.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item and macOS places it. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. To choose where new items go, use Settings > General > New items appear in.
issues.note: Same as #344. The new item part is #767.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Add preference key to display certain default icons
issues.headline: Deploy a default set of shown icons with a configuration profile
issues.symptom: A request for an admin preference that sets which icons are shown on first launch.
issues.fix: Not started. Settings > Advanced > Export Settings and Import Settings move settings between Macs, but item order isn't included.
issues.note: Related to #26.

issues.title: "Search menu bar items" (command palette) lists "always-hidden" items, but nothing happens when you activate them (by pressing Enter)
issues.headline: Search can't open always-hidden items
issues.symptom: Pressing Enter on an always-hidden item in the search panel did nothing.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: Search shows always-hidden items the same way as hidden ones, and that path was reworked in #513 and #729.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Group Menu Icon with notification count (sum of the app in the group)
issues.headline: Group icon with a combined notification count
issues.symptom: A request for one group icon that opens several apps and shows their total notification count.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.
issues.note: Same as #46. Apps don't share their notification counts with Icey.

issues.title: [Bug]: <Automatic adding items when Ice bar is enabled>
issues.headline: Clicking an item in the Ice Bar moves it into the menu bar
issues.symptom: Clicking a hidden item in the Ice Bar showed it in the menu bar.
issues.fix: This is expected. An item must be in the menu bar to open its menu, and Icey hides it again shortly after.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Hide App Menu
issues.headline: Hide app menus on the left of the menu bar
issues.symptom: A request to hide app menus so only the Apple menu and app name show.
issues.fix: Partly available: Settings > Hotkeys > Toggle application menus, and Settings > Advanced > Hide app menus when showing menu bar items. Hiding single menus isn't possible because each app controls its own menus.

issues.title: [Bug]: <When in full screen, menu bar appears on top monitor>
issues.headline: Menu bar shape outline appears on the other monitor in fullscreen
issues.symptom: With the full or split shape, an outline of the menu bar appeared on the external monitor while an app was fullscreen on the MacBook.
issues.fix: An appearance overlay that lands on another display now hides itself, and each display uses its own fullscreen state.
issues.note: Same as #445. Not yet confirmed on two displays.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Multiple ice bars (folders/menus)
issues.headline: Several Ice Bars as folders
issues.symptom: A request for several Ice Bars that each open a group of items.
issues.fix: Not started. Pull requests welcome.
issues.note: Same as #46.

issues.title: [Bug]: MacOS 26 crash when pressing the "more" button
issues.headline: Ice crashes on macOS 26 when you show hidden items
issues.symptom: On macOS 26, pressing the button that shows hidden items crashed Ice.
issues.fix: The code that crashed is gone, and similar conversions elsewhere no longer crash on unexpected values.
issues.note: Same cause as #977.

issues.title: [Bug]: Ice stops working in Mac OS 26 Tahoe
issues.headline: Ice stops working on macOS 26 Tahoe when you expand the menu bar
issues.symptom: On macOS 26 Tahoe, clicking the dots to expand the menu bar made Ice stop working.
issues.fix: Icey is built on Ice's Tahoe rewrite and works on macOS 26.

issues.title: [Bug]: Searchbar-like Artefact Upon Full-Screen
issues.headline: Bar-shaped artefact on the external display when an app goes fullscreen
issues.symptom: On macOS Tahoe, making a window fullscreen on the built-in display left a bar-shaped artefact over all windows on the external display.
issues.fix: An appearance overlay that lands on another display now hides itself, and each display uses its own fullscreen state.
issues.note: Same as #445 and #636. Not yet confirmed on two displays.

issues.title: [Bug]: Not all icons are shown
issues.headline: Some items don't show next to the notch
issues.symptom: With the hidden section shown, only about 15 items appeared and the rest were missing.
issues.fix: macOS drops items that don't fit beside the notch. Turn on Settings > General > Use Ice Bar to show hidden items below the menu bar instead.
issues.note: Same cause as #589.

issues.title: [Bug]: Issues with F.lux when it's icon is hidden using Ice
issues.headline: f.lux doesn't turn its filter back on after full screen while its item is hidden
issues.symptom: With f.lux's item hidden, f.lux turned its filter off for a full screen video but didn't turn it back on afterwards.
issues.fix: Hidden items are moved off screen, and f.lux seems to need its item on screen for this. Keep f.lux in the visible section, or ask f.lux's developers about it.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Localization
issues.headline: Translate the app into other languages
issues.symptom: A request to translate the interface.
issues.fix: Available: Icey is translated into German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese, and follows the language set in macOS.
issues.note: Same as #230.

issues.title: [Bug]: Possible Menubar icon disappears when NORD VPN started?
issues.headline: An app's item disappears when NordVPN is turned on
issues.symptom: SugarSync's item disappeared and its sign-in was lost when NordVPN connected.
issues.fix: Closed: no cause found in Icey's code, and not reproduced. Open an issue in Icey if it still happens, and it will be reopened.
issues.note: SugarSync most likely quit when the VPN connected. Icey doesn't quit apps or remove their items.

issues.title: [Bug]: menu bar layout not recalling prior after restart
issues.headline: Menu bar layout isn't remembered after a restart
issues.symptom: After a restart, items were spread over the wrong sections and had to be arranged again.
issues.fix: Icey now saves where its icon and dividers are when it quits, and repairs them if they end up out of order, so items come back in their sections.
issues.note: Upstream closed it as #344. The whole layout changing at once is #769 and #702.

issues.title: [Bug]: menu background is placed wrong when using a second screem
issues.headline: Menu bar background appears in the wrong place with a second display
issues.symptom: With a second display, the menu bar shape or tint was drawn somewhere on the desktop, such as at the bottom of the screen.
issues.fix: An appearance overlay that lands on another display now hides itself, and each display uses its own fullscreen state.
issues.note: Same as #445. Not yet confirmed on two displays.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: pause functionality when connected to big screen
issues.headline: Turn the Ice Bar or hiding off on a large external display
issues.symptom: A request to use Ice only on the notched built-in display, and to show every item on a large external display.
issues.fix: Available: Settings > Displays has, for each display, Use Ice Bar (Follow, On or Off) and Show hidden items automatically. Settings > General > Use Ice Bar > Use on can also limit the Ice Bar to displays narrower than a width you set.

issues.title: [Bug]: Clicking on Other Networks in Wifi settings exits Ice Bar Menu
issues.headline: Wi-Fi menu closes when clicking Other Networks
issues.symptom: After opening Wi-Fi from the hidden items and clicking Other Networks, the menu closed and the items were hidden again.
issues.fix: A click inside a shown item's menu or panel no longer counts as a click outside the menu bar, so smart rehide doesn't close it while it is in use.
issues.note: Same fix as #621. Not tested with the Wi-Fi menu, and not reproduced with the Ice Bar.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Dim the menubar to work with hazeover harmoniously
issues.headline: HazeOver doesn't dim the menu bar appearance
issues.symptom: HazeOver's dimming didn't cover the area where Ice draws the menu bar appearance.
issues.fix: Icey draws the menu bar appearance at the menu bar's own window level, which is above HazeOver's dimming. Turn off the tint and shape in Menu Bar Appearance, or ask HazeOver's developer to dim above the menu bar.

issues.title: [Bug]: Badgeify icons are placed in always hidden section
issues.headline: Badgeify items go back to the always-hidden section
issues.symptom: Badgeify's items returned to the always-hidden section each time their app was reopened.
issues.fix: The app recreates its item, and macOS puts new items at the far left, in the leftmost section. Move it back in Menu Bar Layout. Remembering each item's place is a feature request (#548, #26).
issues.note: Same as #344.

issues.title: [Bug]: The native Shazam icon can't be placed in Ice in MacOS Sequoia 15.1.1
issues.headline: Shazam's item can't be moved
issues.symptom: The Music Recognition (Shazam) item couldn't be moved and didn't appear in Menu Bar Layout.
issues.fix: macOS before 15.3.2 doesn't let that item be hidden, so Icey leaves it alone.
issues.note: Same as #440.

issues.title: [Bug]: <ice cannot arrange menubar items in automatically hidden menu bars>
issues.headline: Can't arrange items when the menu bar hides automatically
issues.symptom: Menu Bar Layout showed an error instead of the items when the menu bar was set to hide automatically.
issues.fix: Icey no longer blocks Menu Bar Layout, the Ice Bar or the appearance editor when the menu bar hides automatically.
issues.note: Upstream closed it as #201. Not yet tested with a menu bar that hides automatically.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: <Newly installed apps should have their icon put into the "Always visible" group, not into "always hidden">
issues.headline: New items go to the always-hidden section
issues.symptom: Newly installed apps put their item in the always-hidden section, where it was hard to find.
issues.fix: Settings > General > New items appear in: choose Visible, Hidden or Always-Hidden. Icey moves items from an app it hasn't seen before to that section once, and leaves them alone after that.
issues.note: Same as #6. An app that forgets its item's position comes back at the far left each launch, and Icey only moves it the first time.

issues.title: [Feature Request]: Random play wallpaper support enhance
issues.headline: Menu bar shape changes abruptly when the wallpaper changes
issues.symptom: A request for a smooth transition when a rotating wallpaper changes, instead of an abrupt switch.
issues.fix: Not started. macOS no longer announces wallpaper changes, so Icey checks the wallpaper every few seconds and swaps it without a transition. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: [Bug]: 1password app always be hidden automaticlly
